BombVault 7.8.1 fixes "Select files" failing with a generic error after a stale lock, and fixes off-site backup credentials being invisible in Simple mode.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **"Select files" no longer fails with a generic "Failed to load files".** A stale exclusive lock left behind by an earlier interrupted operation (a killed backup, an off-site replication or check that did not finish cleanly) blocked the file-listing call, the same way it could block a backup, but the file-listing path never got the self-heal the backups list already had. It now self-heals the same way, and clears the stale lock automatically instead of failing.
- **File-listing errors now show the real reason.** Both file-listing panels showed a generic message even when the server already sent back the specific cause. The real message is shown now, matching how the rest of the app already handles errors.
- **Off-site rclone and cloud credentials are visible again in Simple mode.** The credential cards on Settings' Off-site tab were wrongly hidden behind Advanced mode, while the repo-path field right next to them has always been visible by default. A Simple-mode user had no visible way to enter off-site credentials at all except by going through the Recovery page. Both cards now show up directly on the Off-site tab.
- **The documentation button on the README now matches the "Buy me a coffee" button's size and colour.**

## Upgrading

Just pull the new image.
